projectDescription: Step-by-step guide to configure, download, compile, and flash Qualcomm Linux and associated firmware on supported Qualcomm development kits.
keyFeatures: Build Qualcomm Linux from source using prebuilt proprietary binaries (public access)
Build with firmware sources for registered/authorized Qualcomm users
QSC CLI for automated download, compile, and flash workflow
Yocto-based BSP image builds with kas tooling
Flash software images to devices via QDL or PCAT
Multi-SoC support: QCS6490, QCS5430, IQ-9075, IQ-8275, IQ-615
Troubleshooting guidance for Docker, sync, build, and flash issues
How-to guides for developer workflows, SDK generation, and network setup
